correctness.rationale: Exact Johnson adjacency square identity gives every Fourier/harmonic eigenvalue and multiplicity. Every nontrivial harmonic eigenspace is tested, not only the conjectured extremizer. Submetric bound and Schoenberg nesting give a single threshold. The n>=4k critical eigenvalue is controlled by a concave quadratic with its vertex between adjacent Johnson eigenvalues; the positive root is unique. Two asymptotics are obtained from uniform scaled limits with suppression of other modes; exact finite checks were independently replayed.
